stories.headline: Iran launches sustained missile and drone attacks on UAE amid regional war
stories.summary: Iran has conducted weeks of missile and drone attacks targeting UAE infrastructure including airports, oil facilities, and military sites. UAE air defenses have intercepted over 340 ballistic missiles and 1,700+ drones since attacks began. Eight people killed including two UAE military personnel and six foreign nationals. UAE leaders condemned attacks as unprovoked terrorism.
